statement: One source-of-truth mapping for every key claim: artifact -> API -> frontend -> paper -> jury. Enables consistent propagation and is audited by ml/check_claim_consistency.py.

claims.claim_text: After capacity control, synchronized wrist IMU still gives a small HR MAE benefit (A_cap->B ~0.605 bpm, C->B ~0.776 bpm, 5/5 seeds).
The raw A->B ~20.6% is capacity-confounded and must NOT be presented as pure IMU sensor value.
Shuffled-IMU control also improves over PPG-only, so synchronization explains only part of the gain.
Second PPG site is aggregate-negative for HR but heterogeneous (2/4 subjects better) and s2-dominated; not globally useless.

Adding aligned horizontal EOG to EEG improves 5-class sleep-stage macro-F1 in the primary test (0.7473->0.7693, 4/5 seeds) and again in a prospectively-frozen 8-subject secondary holdout (0.6530->0.6858, 5/5 seeds); same-dataset, replicated-with-control.

Capacity-identical shuffled-EOG negative control is consistently worse than aligned EOG (C->B 5/5 seeds primary and secondary; A->C ~neutral) -> benefit depends on temporal alignment. Primary per-subject effect is concentrated in SC4011.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Case 3 negative-control + primary per-subject breakdowns

claims.claim_text: Prospective Sleep-EDF secondary holdout (n=8, frozen before evaluation, zero retraining) SUPPORTS the primary finding: A->B 5/5 seeds, 6/8 subjects B>A, 7/8 B>C. Not independent-dataset replication; primary (n=3) and secondary (n=8) are never pooled.
The final/global architecture is UNRESOLVED and Pareto readiness is NOT_READY (honest).
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Architecture Status + Global Readiness

claims.claim_text: The Biological Digital Twin is architecture-only, untrained, unvalidated (a synthetic demo exists).
Spaceflight/microgravity is motivation only; no astronaut or microgravity data validates anything.

In the secondary holdout, N3 per-class F1 regresses under aligned EOG (B-A ~-0.043) while REM gains strongly (+0.150). Read-only diagnostic: N3 recall improves but precision drops (B over-labels true N2 as N3). Disclosed limitation, not smoothed away.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Case 3 secondary class-level breakdown

claims.claim_text: Every checkpoint-based canonical result was independently re-evaluated from frozen weights under the verified frozen environment with exactly zero numerical difference; the full 114-condition robustness sweep reproduced within a documented float32 tolerance (max 7.6e-6 bpm). Overall: SCIENTIFIC_REPRODUCTION_PASS. This is re-evaluation from frozen artifacts on the same stack, NOT independent-dataset replication.

The scientific training/evaluation environment was verified field-by-field against the frozen manifest (Python 3.13.0, PyTorch 2.6.0+cpu, NumPy 2.5.2, SciPy 1.18.1, scikit-learn 1.9.0, MNE 1.12.1, WFDB 4.3.1, pandas 3.0.5): EXACT_FROZEN_ENVIRONMENT, no package changed to force a match.
All 266 raw input records used by the canonical experiments (PPG-DaLiA 16, PTT 198, Sleep primary 36, Sleep secondary 16) are present and fingerprinted; zero raw files are committed to git.

The full 114-condition PPG-DaLiA fault-robustness sweep was re-run from the local frozen checkpoint (no retraining); all 114 conditions match within 1e-4 bpm (max observed 7.6e-6 bpm, float32 rounding noise).

One predeclared, capacity-fair (112 params/channel) factorial experiment (Sleep-EDF EEG x EOG x Resp) gives an interaction term of +0.0031 +/- 0.0434 macro-F1 (2/5 seeds positive): approximately additive / unresolved. Adding both EOG and respiration showed no stable extra benefit beyond their individual effects under this model and dataset. This does NOT prove sensor interactions are globally absent and is NOT an EOG+Resp synergy claim.

Adding horizontal EOG for sleep staging needs 2 lateral-ocular sensing electrodes (interpretation-independent); under a shared-reference head-module architecture it reuses the existing ADS1299-class reference/bias and adds no new module (standalone: 3-4 contacts, possibly a new front-end). Incremental power and mass remain NOT_READY. The EOG contact burden is NOT zero.

The wrist IMU reference operating point is ~0.018 mW (band 0.018-0.378 mW, BMI270 accel-only, gyro OFF) at the documented 25 Hz point for the 32 Hz scientific requirement. This is a component-boundary reference power, NOT wrist-module or system power.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness > IMU candidate

claims.claim_text: The wrist sensor-electronics reference power is an LED-excluded LOWER BOUND (~0.048-0.413 mW across wrist-light/cabin cases), excluding LED, MCU, radio, regulator, and battery. It is not wrist-module power and must never be summed into a system total.
The chest ECG AFE reference power is 0.67 mW (2 channels x 335 uW/ch, ADS1292R at 250 s/s). This is an AFE-only boundary, not chest-module or system power.

In the REFERENCE_SHARED_HEAD_MODULE case, EOG adds +2 lateral-ocular sensing contacts and 0 new module (shared reference/bias on a spare ADS1299-class channel). Incremental head-AFE power and mass remain NOT_READY. The shared case is not asserted as the final wearable architecture.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness > EOG candidate

claims.claim_text: The partial system RAW data-rate lower bound is ~48.068 kbps (scientific-use-case head), excluding light and thoracic+leg BioZ, protocol overhead, and compression. It is a raw payload lower bound, NOT radio bandwidth; RADIO_DATA_RATE is NOT_READY.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness panel (Raw data rate)

claims.claim_text: System average power is NOT_READY. Component/AFE and sensing-electronics reference boundaries exist, but a defensible system-average power requires LED timing, EEG/BioZ operating points, MCU/radio behavior, regulator efficiency, and deployable duty schedules; no total is fabricated.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness panel (System average power)

claims.claim_text: System mass is NOT_READY. All modules are Tier 0; package dimensions are not wearable mass (PCB, battery, enclosure, electrodes, attachments, and wiring dominate and are unquantified). No mass number is asserted.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness panel (System mass)

claims.claim_text: Module BOM readiness is PARTIAL: MCU/radio/regulator/battery advanced MISSING -> REFERENCE_SELECTED (class level, final=false); electrodes/PCB/enclosure/attachment/wiring remain MISSING. REFERENCE_SELECTED is not a final component and there is no final BOM.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness panel (Module BOM)

claims.claim_text: Formal Pareto is NOT_READY. Benefit axes are not comparable across targets (HR MAE vs sleep macro-F1) and system power/mass are incomplete; no frontier is computed. Day-11 Part-2 engineering evidence did not downgrade any Pareto blocker.
claims.frontend_surface: Research Mode > Engineering readiness panel (Formal Pareto)
